name: JiraRequirementReview
description: Reviews one Jira requirement (or a batch via Sprint/JQL query) across the issue, its parent card, its subtasks, its linked issues, and an optional meeting transcript, then produces a structured review of Assumptions, Open Questions, Requirement Gaps, Ambiguities, Edge Cases, Missing Functional/Technical Details, Missing Acceptance Criteria, and Dependency Questions (each with evidence source, confidence, and priority where applicable), plus an overall readiness score and executive summary per issue. By default it returns a draft for you to copy into Jira; turn on 'Publish to Jira' to have it post the comment to each issue directly, and 'Generate Word Report' to also produce a downloadable .docx report.

triggers.name: issue_key
triggers.description: Target Jira issue to review (e.g. ABC-123). Provide this OR a Sprint / JQL query.

triggers.name: jql_override
triggers.description: A Sprint or JQL query to review a batch of issues (e.g. 'project = KS AND status = "To Do"' or 'sprint = "Sprint 42"'). Provide this OR a single Jira Issue Key.

triggers.name: include_parent
triggers.description: Also read the parent card's description and comments (default true).

triggers.name: include_subtasks
triggers.description: Also read the target's subtasks' descriptions and comments (default true).

triggers.name: include_linked_issues
triggers.description: Also read linked issues (blocks/relates-to/etc.) to surface Dependency Question findings (default true).

triggers.name: include_attachments
triggers.description: Also read the files attached to the issue (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, text, meeting transcripts .vtt/.srt and images). The requirement is often in the attached spec rather than the description (default true).

triggers.name: include_confluence
triggers.description: Also read Confluence pages the issue links to, and the files attached to those pages. Only pages on the same Atlassian site are read (default true).

triggers.name: transcript_file
triggers.description: Optional. The meeting transcript (.vtt keeps who spoke and when) and any other files the requirement lives in — a spec (.docx, .pdf), notes. Several can be uploaded at once. A transcript may cover multiple cards; only the parts relevant to each reviewed issue are used. Requires object storage (TENANT_ID) configured.

triggers.name: post_to_jira
triggers.description: If ON, the agent posts the review as a comment directly on each reviewed Jira issue (visible per your Jira's normal comment rules). If OFF, it only returns a draft for you to copy/paste into Jira yourself. Default OFF.

triggers.name: generate_docx
triggers.description: If ON, also produces a consolidated Word (.docx) review report (all reviewed issues) as a download link. Requires object storage (TENANT_ID) configured. Default OFF.

triggers.name: comment_id
triggers.description: Set by the router on the webhook path: the id of the Jira comment that asked for this review, so the review answers what was actually asked. Leave blank when triggering manually.

triggers.name: mode
triggers.description: Set by the router to 'delegated', which returns a structured result and writes NOTHING to Jira so the router can post exactly one reply. Leave blank for a normal manual run.

triggers.name: run_id
triggers.description: Set by the router: the correlation id that appears in the Jira comment, the email and every log line for this run. Leave blank when triggering manually.
